visualCharacteristics.purpose: In-page navigation to the sections of the current page
visualCharacteristics.layout: One ruled row of anchors (>= 960); accordion with scroll-spy label row (< 960); collapses when pinned
notable: Targets are section ids set via Section Metadata
Scroll spy highlights the current section
rule variant adds a horizontal rule band above
numbered variant adds running numbers and scroll arrows

contentPattern.structure: one cell holding a bulleted list of in-page links to section ids

usage: Use on long pages to let readers jump to sections.
reuseGuidance: Fits a list of #anchor links to sections on the same page; not for links to other pages.
